what: hir-expand builtin/fn_macro.rs assert_expand line 471: before edition 2021, `assert!(cond, msg..)` expands to `#dollar_crate::panic!(msg..)`, i.e. core's panic!, whose panic_2015 arm calls `panicking::panic_str_2015(expr: &str)`. rustc (rustc_builtin_macros assert.rs panic_path) writes an unqualified `panic` with the call-site span, so it resolves at the call site: std's panic! (`rt::begin_panic<M: Any + Send>`) in a std crate, core's only under no_std. So blaze gives E0308 `expected &str, found integer` for `assert!(false, 123)` / `assert!(false, v)` in a 2015/2018 std crate, which rustc builds (superset-of-rust). Fix: in the `None =>` arm, quote `panic!(# #panic_args)` with call_site_span and no `$crate::` path. Seen in blaze-diagnostics tests::lints::bodies::calls::methods::non_fmt_panic::{non_fmt_panic, non_fmt_panic_2018} (6 E0308 at non-fmt-panic.rs:28,30,80,85,90,95, round 15), which then hide all 35 non_fmt_panics warnings.
